entries.description: Review a code change for bugs, risks and clarity, with findings ranked by severity. Use when the person shares a diff, a function or a pull request and asks for a review.
entries.author: Fabio Anjos Junior

entries.description: Write a good commit message from a diff or a description of a change. Use when the person asks for a commit message or a pull request title and description.
entries.author: Fabio Anjos Junior

entries.description: Write down a decision with its context, the options considered and the reasons, so it can be understood later. Use when the person settles a technical or product choice and wants it recorded.
entries.author: Fabio Anjos Junior

entries.description: Draft a clear, polite email from a few points. Use when the person asks to write, reply to or rewrite an email or a message to someone.
entries.author: Fabio Anjos Junior

entries.description: Explain a hard idea in plain words with an everyday example. Use when the person says they do not understand something, asks for a simple explanation, or asks to explain it like they are new to the topic.
entries.author: Fabio Anjos Junior

entries.description: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into a short summary with decisions, action items and open questions. Use when the person pastes notes from a meeting or asks what was agreed.
entries.author: Fabio Anjos Junior

entries.description: Produce a short, honest research brief on a topic, separating what is known from what is uncertain. Use when asked to research, compare options or give an overview of a subject.
entries.author: Fabio Anjos Junior

entries.description: Build a weekly status update from the person's notes, tasks or messages. Use when asked for a weekly report, a status update or a recap of the week.
